emuni.tagline: A Euro-Mediterranean university on the Slovenian coast, taught in English.
emuni.about: EMUNI is an intergovernmental university founded in 2008 as a joint project of the Euro-Mediterranean partnership countries, based on the Slovenian coast. Programmes are taught in English in cooperation with a network of partner universities across the Mediterranean, and in summer it hosts the HALS summer school in Piran and Koper.

metu.tagline: Creative and business programmes in Budapest, rated four QS stars.
metu.about: Budapest Metropolitan University is Hungary's largest private university, with strong creative and business faculties. The QS Stars system awarded it four stars out of five, with the maximum five for internationalisation. Teaching is in English, with autumn and spring intakes.

aydin.tagline: Over 40,000 students from more than 100 countries, on Istanbul's European side.
aydin.about: Founded in 2007, Istanbul Aydin University has grown into one of Turkey's most respected private universities — over 40,000 students, more than 4,000 of them international from over 100 countries, and cooperation with 450+ universities through Erasmus+. The campus is in the Florya district, close to the airport and the city centre.

nicosia.tagline: The largest private university in Cyprus, with more than 80 master's programmes.
nicosia.about: The University of Nicosia was founded in 1980 and today draws students from over 100 countries. It is known for medicine, business and information technology. It offers undergraduate degrees in business administration, more than 80 master's programmes — many of them available online — and around twenty doctoral programmes. It also has a campus in Athens.

ais.tagline: A Swiss business school with over 30 years of history, by Lake Geneva.
ais.about: A private international business school on the Swiss Riviera, between Lausanne and Lake Geneva. It is accredited by IACBE (USA), partners with IATA, IBM and Apple, and ranks among the top 4 in Switzerland for master's programmes. Admission is rolling, with main intakes in October and February.

cbs.tagline: A practice-focused German business school — Cologne, Mainz and Potsdam.
cbs.about: CBS International Business School was founded in 1993 and is now one of Germany's leading business schools, with campuses in Cologne, Mainz and Potsdam. The focus is on practical education that connects theory to real business cases. Accreditations: FIBAA, IACBE and the German Wissenschaftsrat.

eubs.tagline: Barcelona, Geneva and Munich — business degrees taught in English.
eubs.about: EU Business School teaches every programme in English across its Barcelona, Geneva and Munich campuses, plus a digital campus. Bachelor's degrees take three years and master's programmes one year, with intakes in October, February and — for some programmes — June or August.

ibs.tagline: Budapest, Vienna and Dubai — degrees accredited in the United Kingdom.
ibs.about: IBS is a private business school founded in 1991 in Budapest, with campuses in Vienna and Dubai as well. All programmes are taught exclusively in English, and the degrees are UK-accredited through a partnership with the University of Buckingham. The main intake is in September, with a spring intake in February.

wittenborg.tagline: A Dutch university with six start dates a year.
wittenborg.about: Wittenborg University was founded in 1987 in Apeldoorn, in the heart of the Netherlands, and hosts over 1,200 students from more than 100 countries. Teaching is 100% in English, with campuses in Amsterdam and Munich. Studies can begin six times a year — roughly every two months. Accreditations: NVAO and FIBAA.

ucam.tagline: A Catholic university in Murcia, known for sport and health sciences.
ucam.about: Universidad Católica San Antonio de Murcia was founded in 1996 and draws students from over 60 countries, with campuses in Murcia, Cartagena and Madrid. It is known for health sciences and high-performance sport, and programmes are taught in Spanish and English. Admission is rolling — bachelor's usually by 31 July, master's by 31 August.

fsm.tagline: Ottoman architecture and modern engineering in historic Istanbul.
fsm.about: Fatih Sultan Mehmet Vakıf University was founded in 2010 and hosts over 8,000 students. Its campuses occupy Ottoman buildings in Istanbul's historic core — Topkapı, Haliç and Yenikapı Mevlevihanesi. Teaching is in Turkish, English and Arabic, and applications run from May to August for the September intake.

aubg.tagline: An American liberal arts degree at the foot of the Rila mountains.
aubg.about: The American University in Bulgaria was founded in 1991 in Blagoevgrad, an hour from Sofia at the foot of the Rila mountains. It hosts over 1,000 students from more than 40 countries, teaches in English, and offers 13 bachelor's programmes plus a 16-month Executive MBA for working professionals.

jcu.tagline: An American university in Rome's Trastevere, taught in English.
jcu.about: John Cabot University is an American university in the heart of Rome, in the Trastevere district. Teaching is in English — apart from Italian language courses — and students from around the world also come for two five-week summer sessions that carry recognised academic credit.

gbsb.tagline: A digital-first business school — Barcelona, Madrid and Malta.
gbsb.about: GBSB Global Business School teaches in English in Barcelona, Madrid and Birkirkara in Malta, with an emphasis on digital business and applied artificial intelligence. Intakes are in October, January and April, with scholarships covering 15 to 30 per cent of tuition.

bts.tagline: A technology school in the 22@ Poblenou innovation district.
bts.about: Barcelona Technology School specialises in technology and AI programmes, with a campus in the Eixample district and close ties to startups in the 22@ Poblenou innovation district. Teaching is in English and project-based, and in summer it runs an intensive course on the fundamentals of artificial intelligence.

htl.tagline: Hospitality, tourism and languages in Barcelona — four intakes a year.
htl.about: HTL International School of Hospitality, Tourism and Languages has more than 15 years of experience and is listed among Europe's top 10 hospitality management schools. Teaching is in English, bachelor's degrees take three years, and there are four intakes a year — January, April, July and October.

mai.tagline: Russia's leading school of aviation, rocketry and space engineering.
mai.about: The Moscow Aviation Institute was founded in 1930 and specialises in aviation, aeronautics, rocketry and space engineering. It hosts over 20,000 students from more than 50 countries, and programmes are taught in Russian and English. Admission is rolling, with main intakes in October and February.

srh.tagline: A German university of applied sciences — Berlin and Heidelberg.
srh.about: SRH University teaches in English in Berlin and Heidelberg, focusing on renewable energy, artificial intelligence and sustainability. Alongside its degree programmes it runs short summer schools — on solar systems in Berlin, and on AI and sustainability in Heidelberg.

kozminski.tagline: Business and economics taught in English, in the heart of Warsaw.
kozminski.about: Kozminski University is a private university in Warsaw's Praga Północ district, known for business and economics programmes taught in English. Classes run on weekdays with weekend activities, and in summer it hosts an International Summer School for university students and a separate school for high-school students.

emuni.tagline: Healthy, active living through kinesiology, Mediterranean nutrition and VR in healthcare.
emuni.about: A five-day summer school devoted to a healthy and active lifestyle. Lectures and workshops are led by recognised experts in kinesiology, nutrition and the use of VR technology in healthcare, with around 20 teaching hours on the Adriatic coast. The fee depends on group size, and payment in instalments is possible.
included: Around 20 hours of classes and workshops
Certificate and 3 ECTS credits with transcript
Guided tour of Piran's old town
emuni.accommodation: Student residences and partner properties in Piran and Koper — single or twin rooms. Meals are not included in the fee.
emuni.certificate: Certificate of completion plus 3 ECTS credits with a transcript of records.

metu.tagline: Two weeks of business, marketing and international relations in the heart of Budapest.
metu.about: A two-week programme at Budapest Metropolitan University covering human resources, marketing, international relations, tourism innovation and business strategy. Classes run four days a week, around five hours a day.
metu.accommodation: Optional add-on: single room with breakfast €1,300, twin room €1,100. The course alone, without accommodation, costs €600.
metu.certificate: Certificate of completion issued by Budapest Metropolitan University.

aydin.tagline: Ten to twelve courses, ECTS credits and the Bosphorus — Istanbul in summer and winter.
aydin.about: A two-week programme with 10–12 courses: brand management, international relations, digital marketing, genetics and artificial intelligence in business. Classes run 2–3 hours a day alongside workshops and team work, and the programme runs in both summer and winter.
aydin.dates: Late July — early August, and late January
aydin.accommodation: Student halls, hotels and apartments — around €500–800 for the whole programme. Not included in the course fee.
aydin.certificate: Certificate with 3–6 ECTS credits, transferable to your home university.

eubs.tagline: A business programme for high-school students, full board and a Barcelona campus.
eubs.about: A two-week programme for high-school students aged 16 to 18 who want a first taste of an international business environment. Classes run on weekday mornings, with interactive workshops, case studies and project work. Travel to Barcelona and the airport transfer are not included.
included: Full board — three meals a day
eubs.accommodation: Student residence in twin rooms, with Wi-Fi, security and housekeeping — included in the fee.
eubs.certificate: EU Business School certificate of completion.

bts.tagline: Two weeks of generative artificial intelligence in Barcelona's tech district.
bts.about: A project-based programme for participants aged 18 and over who want the fundamentals of artificial intelligence, generative AI in particular. It combines theory, hands-on workshops and interactive sessions — around 20 hours a week, in the 22@ Poblenou innovation district.
included: Visits to tech companies and startups
bts.accommodation: Not included — BTS recommends student residences, hostels or shared flats, roughly €400–800 for two weeks.
bts.certificate: Official Barcelona Technology School certificate of attendance.

ucam.tagline: Spanish from A1 to C2 in an 18th-century monastery, with flamenco and day trips.
ucam.about: An intensive Spanish course for non-native speakers, taught through the communicative method in small groups of 8 to 15 students. Classes are held on the Los Jerónimos campus, housed in an 18th-century monastery.
ucam.accommodation: Host family with full board (package from €1,540), student halls, hotels or private apartments.
ucam.certificate: Official UCAM certificate stating the number of weeks and your CEFR level, plus 2–4 ECTS credits.

jcu.tagline: Two five-week sessions in Trastevere — academic credit in the heart of Rome.
jcu.about: John Cabot University, in Rome's Trastevere district, runs two five-week summer sessions. Students take one or two courses from art history, business, communications, economics, literature, psychology and studio arts.
included: One or two courses per session
jcu.accommodation: Residences and apartments close to the campus in Trastevere.
jcu.certificate: Recognised academic credit — 3 or 6 ECTS for completed courses.

gbsb.tagline: Applied artificial intelligence for business — Barcelona or Malta.
gbsb.about: An intensive two-week programme on generative artificial intelligence and its business applications, taught through interactive lectures, group work, case studies and hands-on AI projects. No prior AI knowledge is required — only a working command of English.
gbsb.accommodation: Student halls or partner hostels near the campus — single room €350–500, shared room €250–400.

srh.tagline: Eighteen days of solar systems, wind and bioenergy — in Berlin or online.
srh.about: An intensive course on solar systems: designing, installing and managing on-grid, off-grid and hybrid photovoltaic setups, with workshops on wind and bioenergy. SRH also runs a two-week International SustAInability Summer School in Heidelberg on AI, IoT and sustainability.
srh.accommodation: Not included — roughly €400–700 a month, with recommendations from the university.
srh.certificate: Zertifikat / Certificate listing the topics covered and the number of hours.

aubg.tagline: Four programmes — from TOEFL prep and robotics to leadership, ages 8 to 17.
aubg.about: The American University in Bulgaria runs four summer programmes: TOEFL preparation (4 weeks), a Sci-Tech Academy with robotics and experiments (2 weeks), summer English for children aged 8 to 12 (3 weeks), and Leadership & Civic Engagement for ages 15 to 17.
included: Full-day schedule on the Leadership course
aubg.accommodation: On-campus dormitories, optional. An airport transfer from Sofia is required — Blagoevgrad is about a two-hour drive away.

kozminski.tagline: AI in business, fintech and sustainability — plus a track for high-school students.
kozminski.about: Kozminski runs two summer programmes: the International Summer School for university students, with courses on artificial intelligence in business, sustainability, data visualisation, fintech and leadership; and the Warsaw Summer School for high-school students, introducing marketing, finance, management and AI.
activities: Old Town and the Royal Castle
kozminski.accommodation: Not included — recommendations via PepeHousing and Spotahome, roughly €120–190 a month.
kozminski.certificate: Certificate of completion, plus 4 ECTS credits per course on the International Summer School.

europea.tagline: A week of discovering your profession — business, tech, design, healthcare and sport.
europea.about: A short, intensive camp for high-school students still choosing a career. Through workshops running from 9.30 to 17.30, participants try out business, technology, design, healthcare and sport, with visits to faculties, laboratories and hospital and studio simulations.
europea.accommodation: This is a day camp, so accommodation is not required — optional university residences or hotels in Madrid.
europea.certificate: Official Summer Camp certificate of attendance evidencing the skills gained.
